body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). Four test files in plugins/adlc-pi/test/ (commands.test.mjs, completion-prosecute.test.mjs, exec-fail-closed.test.mjs, extension.test.mjs) manually invoke mkdtempSync across 18 calls and guard removals in 50 try/finally blocks, and are allowlisted in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs. With @adlc/core/test-kit (tmp), fixture directories automatically register cleanup via t.after when passed the test context t.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In plugins/adlc-pi/test/commands.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update tests to accept t and replace mkdtempSync with tmp(t, 'pi-commands-').
   - Remove manual try/finally blocks, unindenting test bodies.
2. In plugins/adlc-pi/test/completion-prosecute.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update tests to accept t and replace mkdtempSync with tmp(t, 'pi-compl-pros-').
   - Remove manual try/finally blocks, unindenting test bodies.
3. In plugins/adlc-pi/test/exec-fail-closed.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update tests to accept t and replace mkdtempSync with tmp(t, 'pi-exec-fc-').
   - Remove manual try/finally blocks, unindenting test bodies.
4. In plugins/adlc-pi/test/extension.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update tests to accept t and replace mkdtempSync with tmp(t, 'pi-ext-').
   - Remove manual try/finally blocks, unindenting test bodies.
5. In scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs:
   - Remove plugins/adlc-pi/test/commands.test.mjs, plugins/adlc-pi/test/completion-prosecute.test.mjs, plugins/adlc-pi/test/exec-fail-closed.test.mjs, and plugins/adlc-pi/test/extension.test.mjs from the ALLOWLIST set.
6. Verification:
   - node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/commands.test.mjs plugins/adlc-pi/test/completion-prosecute.test.mjs plugins/adlc-pi/test/exec-fail-closed.test.mjs plugins/adlc-pi/test/extension.test.mjs exits 0.
   - node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 All 4 test files contain 0 finally blocks.
- AC2 mkdtempSync is not called in any of the 4 test files.
- AC3 None of the 4 test files appear in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs ALLOWLIST.
- AC4 All tests in the 4 files pass cleanly under node --test.
- AC5 node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC6 adlc rails-guard exits 0.
title: refactor(adlc-pi): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit and eliminate 50 try/finally blocks in commands and execution tests
